description: Live-fetches a domain's /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /sitemap.xml, and /.well-known/{x402,mcp,agent-card.json} files, returning a per-bot permission matrix (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot), AI-crawler readiness score (0-100), and ICE fixes. Use geo_page_audit for HTML/TTFB signals or schema_citation_check for JSON-LD validation.

url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP URL to audit live (e.g. https://example.com).

name: ai_crawler_audit

iceActionPlan.description: Prioritized ICE remediation actions ordered by impact and effort.

llmsTxt.description: Presence and structure analysis for llms.txt and llms-full.txt.

robotsTxt.description: Fetched robots.txt status and parsed AI crawler rules.

sitemapXml.description: XML sitemap discovery and validity checks.

summary.description: Aggregate AI-crawler readiness score (0-100) and bot access matrix.

wellKnown.description: Discovery checks for /.well-known/x402, mcp.json, and agent-card.json.

title: AI Crawler, robots.txt & llms.txt Audit ($0.01)
